You are the **delivery lead**. The board has funded one AI initiative at RetailFlow, and your job is to ship it without the predictable failures. You'll carry one project through three sprints, scoping and stress-testing it by **interviewing the RetailFlow team** ([meet them here](team.qmd)).

Each group takes a **different** initiative, so no two designs look alike. Pick yours:

::: {#initiatives}
:::

## The three sprints

Each sprint hands you one piece of your delivery design. Bring the worksheet (print it, or fill it on your device).

::: {#worksheets}
:::

## How it fits together

1. **Sprint 1: Scope it against reality.** Interview Priya (data) and Marcus (CIO); reconcile "move fast" with "the data isn't ready". → scoped objectives, data needs, a defined *good enough*.
2. **Sprint 2: Stakeholders & human-in-the-loop.** Interview Emma (CEO), Tom (frontline) and David (CFO); decide where a human must stay in charge. → stakeholder plan + checkpoint design.
3. **Sprint 3: Roadmap, risk & the go/no-go.** Build the plan, then defend it when the staff push back and a crisis hits. → roadmap with gates, risk register, the Scale/Pivot/Kill call.

::: {.callout-tip}
The documents you'll need (board memos, data profiles, vendor proposals, policies) are in RetailFlow's internal portal. Not everything there is relevant: part of the job is working out what matters.
:::
